integrity: The structural reduction is symbolic. A standalone exact replay exhaustively enumerates allowed incidence assignments through t=4 and independently checks the connected-component recurrence through t=8, e=10.
scientific_limitations: The count is for finite rooted frames of exact height two with labels; it does not enumerate isomorphism classes.
The one-row specialization N_(2,e)=3^e-2^e is classical and is not claimed as new.
The all-parameter incidence enumeration may exist in general graph-enumeration literature under different terminology; the logical transfer is the narrower originality claim.
title: Partition-lattice census of height-two convex-polyhedral Kripke frames
